testing_and_attributes.rule: ALL interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute formatted in kebab-case

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure all JS components (App.js, etc.) use proper React Hooks and handle API loading states gracefully.
Mock backend API responses for local testing if external backend is not available, but support real REST API calls (POST /diagnose, POST /fix).
Strictly enforce required fields (Symptom, Device Model, One UI version) with clear inline validation before submitting POST /diagnose.
Implement light and dark theme using Tailwind CSS classes ('dark' class on HTML or container) with instant toggle state persistence.
Apply 'data-testid' to every interactive button, input, select, badge, and step card.

Maintain the Samsung GalaxyCare techy & greeky visual hierarchy: prominent dark/light card backgrounds, monospace uppercase labels ('01 / TELL US WHAT'S WRONG'), glowing accent borders, and status indicators.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.anti_ai_slop: Do not make a generic centered SaaS template. Use monospace technical eyebrows, structured grid borders, status badges, and Samsung Galaxy signature cobalt/electric blue tones.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.spacing: Generous spacing scale (p-6 to p-8 inside cards, gap-6 between grid items).
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.animations: Use Framer Motion or smooth Tailwind transitions for step expansion, progress bar fills, and button loading spinners.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.accessibility: High contrast text for both light and dark modes. Meet APCA / WCAG standards on all risk tag badges and status pills.
